fields.title: 1. Lobbying Registration — Filing and Press Coverage
fields.md:
### 1-1. Primary Source: LDA Registration Filing

| Item | Stated in filing | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Registrant | Mehlman Consulting, Inc. (Washington DC) | [LDA filing](https://lda.gov/filings/public/filing/5c7c1f8b-833a-411e-ae0e-3d2d1cde1db7/print/) |
| Client | 'SpaceX' (1 Rocket Road, Starbase TX) | Same |
| Client description | 'Space launch & reentry services; telecommunications; super intelligence; and social media.' | Same |
| Effective date | 2026-10-01 | Same |
| Signed/posted | 2026-11-16 13:47 | Same · [LDA API](https://lda.gov/api/v1/filings/?registrant_name=Mehlman%20Consulting&filing_year=2026&client_name=SpaceX) |
| Issue area codes | AER (Aerospace) · CPI (Computer Industry) · SCI (Science/Technology) · TEC (Telecommunications) — 4 codes | Same |
| Stated issues | 'Monitor issues related to AI/SI, telecom, spaceflight services and supporting infrastructure.' | Same |
| Lobbyists | 7, all newly listed in this filing. Backgrounds are from congressional offices of both parties and the executive branch (many with Democratic congressional office and Vice President's office experience) | Same |
| Income/expenses | Blank (registration stage) | Same |

- **Not in the filing**: Ukraine · Starshield · Starlink · Department of Defense. Based on the filing alone, this engagement is a 'monitoring' contract covering AI, telecommunications and space businesses broadly (Source: LDA filing, accessed 2026-11-22 KST).

### 1-2. Press Coverage

| Item | Content | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Published | Kyiv Post 2026-11-21 14:22 | [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90801) |
| Origin | Cites Fox News reporting — Kyiv Post did not independently verify it. The original Fox News article could not be found (searched 2026-11-22 KST) | Same |
| Account | **5** lobbyists, started 10/1, ties to Democrats and past administrations, upcoming Democratic scrutiny (Ukraine restrictions · Department of Defense reliance on SpaceX · conflicts of interest) | Same |
| Same cluster | dev.ua — 'Hires Democrat-connected lobbyists as defense contracts are threatened by Starshield outage' | [dev.ua](https://dev.ua/en/news/oboronni-kontrakty-spacex-u-ssha-pid-zahrozoiu-cherez-zboi-starshield-v-ukraini-1795259762) |

- **Reading**: The hiring and its date are the same in the filing and the press coverage. The number of lobbyists differs (filing: 7 vs. press: 5) — the filing's number was adopted. Linking the hiring to the Starshield scrutiny is the press's interpretation. The filing's issue description is a broad 'monitoring', so it neither confirms nor denies that interpretation. Which issues were actually handled will first be stated in the Q4 report (LD-2 — estimated to be filed in late 2027-01) (Source: LDA filing · Kyiv Post 11/21 · `state.open_questions_for_next_run`).
